programmes.t: Pure Fly NZ: West Coast Explorer
programmes.d: Good mates Ronan Creane and Jeff Forsee head off on a mission to explore the myriad of trout fishing options available on the beautiful West Coast of NZ's South Island.

programmes.t: Pure Fly NZ: East Cape Raft Mission
programmes.d: NZ fly fishing champion Cory Scott and his good mate Chris Sharland venture deep into the East Cape for a challenging but ultimately rewarding multi-day rafting trip.

programmes.t: Pure Fly NZ: Southland Willow Grubbers
programmes.d: Rene Vaz and Mike Wilkinson head into the deep south during the peak of summer in the hope that the famously large brown trout of the region will have begun feeding heavily on willow grubs.

programmes.t: IFISH: Wyangala Dam, New South Wales
programmes.d: Whether you want to troll lures for cod, collect your own live bait and target yellas, or battle huge mud marlin on small soft plastics - Wyangala Dam is the place to be.
When I asked Shane Compain to pick the best day of the year for myself and the IFISH Team to come smack some serious barramundi - he did not disappoint!

It's not often that you go fishing somewhere so picturesque, so pristine and so untouched that you seriously think to yourself "I wouldn't even care if I didn't get a bite"... but then you absolutely SMACK IT TOO!

programmes.t: IFISH: ATA Lodge, Alagnak River, Alaska - Part 2
programmes.d: When Paul says he guarantee's you won't be disappointed, he ain't lying! Landing monster mutilated hook-jaw zombie chum salmon on fly, while bears patrol the banks, fishing around you. It's gotta be seen to be believed!
Victoria has long been known for its capital city Melbourne, over the top hipsters and its AFL football religion. But 12 pound rainbow trout one after the other? Ahhh...WHAT!

When life gives you lemons - make lemonade. When life gets you down - get back up. When life gives you dead flat seas, 40 degree heat, a sounder lit up like a Christmas tree and 1 hour left of fishing - make great TV!

There's nothing quite like getting back to basics and garfish off the local pier - that's what I love! Learn all the tricks, to ensure you too can grab a feed down your local and even cook them up like a Master Chef!

programmes.t: Pure Fly NZ: Mackenzie Country Canal Trout - Part 1
programmes.d: Angler Anto Hall teams up with Charles Smith for a mission into the Mackenzie Country in search of a canal monster. The team soon learn that fly fishing for these giant fish can be pretty darn tricky!

programmes.t: Pure Fly NZ: Mackenzie Country Canal Trout - Part 2
programmes.d: The team fish into the darkness and battle plummeting temperatures as they chase an an elusive 30lb+ monster in the Mackenzie Country canals.

programmes.t: Pure Fly NZ: North Island Tiki Tour
programmes.d: Andrew Harding and Matt Hince go on a campervan tour of some of the North Island's best back country trout fishing. There's action aplenty, and as usual with these two characters, a lot of laughs!

programmes.t: Pure Fly NZ: Fiordland Mouse Trout
programmes.d: We join Anto Hall and Nick Geddes as they search the remote lakes of Fiordland for the mysterious 'mouse feeding trout' and Anto manages to catch the largest brown trout of his life!

programmes.t: Pure Fly NZ: The Mighty Tongariro
programmes.d: Fly fishing couple Hannah Clement and Tom Hodge hit the Tongariro during the winter spawning run of rainbow trout from Lake Taupo.
